package.description: A unified communications application that keeps you connected with your team and customers.

en-US.description: A unified communications application that keeps you connected with your team and customers.
en-US.longDescription:
However you work, it keeps you connected.
- Search the directory for colleagues
- Dial with one click
- Listen to voicemails and return calls with one click
- Schedule and join meetings
- Share your screen
- Set up call routing rules
- Set your availability state and let others know how to contact you
en-US.name: Mitel Connect

zh-CN.description: 一款助您与团队及客户保持紧密联系的统一通信应用。
zh-CN.longDescription:
无论您如何工作，它都能保持您随时在线。
- 在通讯录中快速查找同事
- 一键直拨通话
- 收听语音信箱并一键回拨
- 安排和加入会议
- 实时共享屏幕
- 自定义来电转接规则
- 设置在线状态并告知他人最佳联系方式
